# aphrody_nsh crate

> Unified Native Shell (nsh) Workspace integration for gpui_app_shell and zed: live TSX hot-reload preview, embedded GpuiCodeEditor native component, Google…

Source: https://docs.aphrody.com/crates/aphrody_nsh/

Unified Native Shell (nsh) Workspace integration for gpui_app_shell and zed: live TSX hot-reload preview, embedded GpuiCodeEditor native component, Google Design/Stitch, and Storytold Craft Studio.

## Workspace dependencies
